arguments.command:
cat /app/OPERATIONS.md && python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, os
p='/app/main.db'
print('db size', os.path.getsize(p))
con=sqlite3.connect('file:'+p+'?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True)
print('journal_mode', con.execute('pragma journal_mode').fetchone())
print('tables', con.execute("select name, sql from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall())
for (name,) in con.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall():
    print(name, con.execute('select * from "'+name.replace('"','""')+'" order by 1').fetchall())
con.close()
PY
